evidence.decision: Republic of Paraguay is the formal republican name of the same continuous Paraguayan state represented canonically as Paraguay, not a replacement sovereign identity. Paraguayan Law 6576/2020 commemorates 12 October 1813 as the proclamation of Paraguay as a Republic; the Archivo Nacional de Asunción preserves the 1813 Congress resolutions appointing Francia and Yegros as Cónsules de la República; the 1870 and current 1992 constitutions continue to use República del Paraguay. The reviewed continuity correction relinked Francisco Solano López's 1862-1870 presidency and Alfredo Stroessner's 1954 de facto and 1954-1989 presidential Activities to canonical Paraguay while leaving Francia's constitutionally distinct early Activities unchanged.
